selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Strong architecture-departure representation-path test: adds a compact Cartesian/body-order residual branch from GEN016-M01 to target ISO17 energy/gap without changing benchmark semantics.
Message-passing-path departure: tests whether a bounded descriptor-level edge message improves conformer transfer beyond a static body-order residual.
Low-risk exploit of the body-order evidence: isolates truncated nu=2 invariant residual benefits while avoiding broader message-passing or nonlocal complexity.
Energy-decomposition and nonlocal-information departure: bounded latent electrostatic residual directly targets the observed ISO17 energy/gap bottleneck.
Safer exploit of GEN016-M02: adds element-conditioned hardness stabilization to the latent charge residual to reduce unlabelled-charge instability risk.
Higher-risk combined architecture departure coupling body-order representation with nonlocal energy decomposition; useful if single-path mechanisms underfit the ISO17 bottleneck.
Training-target-path probe: pairs a minimal body-order residual with modest code-level energy/force reweighting to test whether source ISO17 energy instability is partly objective imbalance.
Exact source control replicate for generation_015/proposal_004, needed to interpret architecture-departure gains against run variance.

selection_policy: architecture-departure selection: cover representation path, message passing path, energy decomposition path, nonlocal information path, and training-target path while retaining one exact control and avoiding local-only BalancedInteractionBlock/vector-norm/gate/norm/adapter variants.

omitted_proposals.reason: Useful backward-simplify radial/type ablation, but lower priority than selecting both the fuller representation-path tests and the required training-target probe within the eight-unit budget.
Explicitly weak physics-regularization wildcard with extra training cost; deferred in favor of stronger mechanism-card / patch-blueprint-backed architecture departures and the exact control.
